summary.text: JD Chaplin is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 29, which covers Chesterfield, Darlington, Lee, Marlboro and Sumter Counties.
His official page lists him as a farmer and a member of the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Chaplin was born on April 7, 1994, and describes himself as a fourth-generation row crop farmer.
His official page lists study at Florence-Darlington Technical College and a B.S. from Charleston Southern University in 2018.
He was president of the Darlington County FFA and received the National FFA Degree, and he earned the Eagle Scout Award in 2012.
He chaired the Darlington County Republican Party from 2017 to 2025.
His committee assignments are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Family and Veterans' Services, Fish, Game and Forestry, Judiciary, and Transportation.
He married Shelby on December 5, 2020, and is a member of Black Creek Baptist Church in Dovesville.
